ideas.title: Following the Money in the Indianapolis Colts Owner's Death
ideas.description: Investigate the financial dealings of Jim Irsay and the Indianapolis Colts to determine if there were any suspicious transactions or activities that may be related to his death.
questions: What were Irsay's financial dealings in the months leading up to his death?
Were there any suspicious transactions or activities?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover important information about the circumstances surrounding Irsay's death and potentially reveal any wrongdoing or suspicious activity.
